Vrok is a trade-goods merchant, distinct from Korag Keeneye’s general-goods and ammunition stock in the same area.

The Abandoned Fuel Tank is a passive environmental hazard. When one or more units come within range, it casts Fuel once, then despawns after four seconds; it returns in a passive state when it respawns.
Breka Wolfsister is a stable master at Bor'gorok Outpost, with pet stabling and lost-companion recovery among her stated duties.
Drigoth is an armorer at Bor'gorok Outpost who sells goods and repairs equipment.
Matron Magah is an innkeeper who speaks of making the new lands “ours.” She presents the inn as a place where battle-weary fighters can rest and share stories of their battles.
Bor'gorok Battleguards are stationed at Bor'gorok Outpost. Their shared identity is that of guards.
Bor'gorok Wolf is a wolf in the Bor'gorok Outpost area, identified by its local name.

Injured Warsong Warrior is a wounded fighter in the Bor'gorok area who promises, “I will protect you, friend!” during a pickup. The rescue interaction is associated with Warlord's Bulwark; in combat, the warrior uses Cleave and Heroic Strike.

An injured Warsong mage, this survivor is carried from danger and answers rescue with thanks. Once safe, he vows that the beasts will feel the Sunwell’s fury, revealing a fierce commitment to strike back.

Apprentice Fraser is a named apprentice who tends a food-and-drink counter. The role pairs practical provisions with the standing of an apprentice, giving this local vendor a clear place among the people serving the area.
Apprentice Rosen is a named apprentice who supplies reagents.
Librarian Whitley is a named librarian who deals in wands. The combination of a scholarly title and a focused stock of magical implements gives Whitley a distinct place among the area’s vendors.

Librarian Andersen is a named librarian who offers alchemy supplies. This practical specialty distinguishes Andersen’s work from the other librarians nearby, linking the scholarly title to a particular craft.

Librarian Hamilton tends herbalism supplies and follows a measured route, pausing at points along the way before turning to continue. The rounds give this named librarian a distinctive routine alongside the practical work of herbalism supplies.
Librarian Jeffers supplies jewelcrafting goods.
Librarian Ingram supplies inscription goods.
Librarian Erickson supplies enchanting goods.
Warmage Calandra is a humanoid warmage in Borean Tundra.
Oogrooq is a poison and reagent supplier.

Caregiver Poallu is a tuskarr innkeeper. One conditional greeting welcomes visitors to rest by the fire and jokes about the smell of fish; another eyes visitors suspiciously, says they do not understand tuskarr people, and warns them not to stay long for fear of trouble. Poallu also offers goods to browse.
Tonraq is a spearcrafter who offers goods browsing and repairs.
An Unu'pe Spearman is a spearman in the Unu'pe area.
Tupit is a fishmonger who offers goods browsing.
Alornerk sells general goods and offers goods browsing.
Trapper Saghani is the stable master. His greetings describe help with stabling pets and recovering lost companions.
Tarralikitak trades goods and offers goods browsing.
Initiate Knapp is a humanoid in Borean Tundra.
Initiate Mehrtens is associated with test goods at the Argent Vanguard camp.
Apprentice Ranch is a humanoid apprentice in Borean Tundra.
Initiate Greer tests something that can cause pain, asking how it feels and trying again. Greer also questions whether treating enemies without mercy could make their side no better than its foes.
Initiate Vernon urges others to show enemies no mercy and inflict more pain to get answers.
Trotter bears the title of apprentice.
Initiate Park is a named initiate in the area. He follows a directed route through the area.

Jimmy the Stable Boy is an imaginative boy who talks to horses as friends. He dreams of keeping a horse that would look out for him as he would for it, and imagines he and Anduin becoming friends too. He says friendship matters and asks Celidh whether there are pets he can take to the stable.
A horse kept in the Valiance Keep stable area, identified as a stabled horse.
Ronald Anderson is the stable master at Valiance Keep, associated with pet stabling and help recovering lost companions.
A fisherman associated with Valiance Keep, in the settlement's fishing population.
A peon of Warsong Hold, part of the hold's laboring population.

Argah is a soldier at the Northrend front who has recovered quarry munitions and hopes the charges will soon give the defenders relief from the nerubian siege. He welcomes Saurfang’s arrival and regards him as help for their effort.
Sagai watches the sinkholes and discusses collapsing them to address the threat. He respects Hellscream’s fierceness but considers him too eager to prove himself, and is glad Saurfang has arrived.
Mystic Tomkin is a humanoid in Borean Tundra.
An Unu’pe villager, part of the settlement’s resident population.
A dead caribou in Borean Tundra.

Vanthryn the Merciless is a San'layn lieutenant in Prince Valanar's retinue at Naxxanar. Chieftain Wintergale's account names him among the prince's personal retainers and directs the player to confront him alongside Luthion the Vile. His epithet is part of his name.

Luthion the Vile is a San'layn lieutenant and one of Prince Valanar's personal retainers at Naxxanar. In combat, he uses Blood Presence and Plague Strike. Chieftain Wintergale names him alongside Vanthryn as a target among the prince's lieutenants.
Warmage Archus is a named warmage who follows a route.
Warmage Watkins is a named warmage associated with Coldarra.
Warmage Hollister is a named warmage associated with Coldarra.
Bilko Driftspark is a flight master who offers fast travel. If attacked, he calls enraged gryphons and wyverns to his defense.

Glrglrglr is a captive in the Winterfin Caverns who fears the magic seeping from Coldarra is controlling minds. They are focused on escape and identify Keymaster Urmgrgl as the holder of their cage key.
Hotawa reports alarming news from Moa'ki Harbor and urges a journey by boat from Unu'pe to assist Elder Ko'nani.
A tundra penguin, a small critter of Northrend's northern wastes.
Magistrix Kaelana is Kirin Tor. She explains that Dalaran has moved to Northrend and offers to teleport travelers there; she also entrusts a Kirin Tor signet for Archmage Celindra at the Violet Gate.

Magister Dath'omere is a Kirin Tor magister associated with Dalaran. He greets visitors and offers a teleport to the city. His signet and account of Dalaran's move to Northrend frame him as a guide for those beginning a journey there.
Nurse Applewood is a Grand Master First Aid Trainer.
A Valiance Keep defender is identified as one of the keep's defenders. Several are present in the area, marking them as part of its guard presence.
Malygos calls out in concern over Saragosa's fate.
Librarian Tiare is a figure in the Borean Tundra. She greets visitors and offers a teleport service to Amber Ledge. Her greeting calls the visitor “child,” giving her welcome a gently familiar tone.

Elder Sardis is one of the elders honored during the season when the new year begins and the moon shines bright. He speaks of that time as when the ancients awaken, and welcomes homage to the olden races. His dialogue points visitors toward several other elders, including Northal, Arp, and Pamuya.

Elder Northal shares the elders’ reflection that the new year and bright moon mark a time when the ancients awaken. His greeting describes this as “our time,” placing him among those who observe the occasion. His directions point visitors toward Igasho, Arp, and Sardis.

Elder Arp is one of the elders honored when the new year comes and the moon shines bright, a time he associates with the awakening of the ancients. He also reflects on a past shaped by hunting for glory and honor, and asks whether life is so different now. His directions mention Pamuya and Sardis.

Elder Pamuya recalls days when his people lived for the hunt, seeking glory and honor, and wonders whether the present is so different. His words frame him as a reflective elder looking back on his people’s traditions. His directions point visitors toward Arp, Sardis, and Elder Bluewolf.
A Warsong battleguard is a humanoid guard associated with the Warsong name. This guard is in the Borean Tundra.
Borean marmots are wildlife found across numerous areas of Borean Tundra.
Old Crystalbark is a named elemental combatant in Borean Tundra. In combat, it can cast Mark of Detonation and Arcane Breath.
Fumblub Gearwind is a named combatant in Borean Tundra who can cast Machine Gun.
Icehorn is a named beast and powerful combatant found in Borean Tundra. Its combat behavior includes Romp.
Fishy Ser'ji is identified as a Grand Master Fishing Trainer.

Corastrasza is a red dragonflight drake trainer and Raelorasz’s sister. She studies Malygos’ blue drakes and trains her pets for the conflict. Proud and wary of mortal interference in her family, she nevertheless lets them practice aerial combat with her drakes and acknowledges their improvement.
Logistics Officer Silverstone is the Alliance Vanguard quartermaster. He offers goods to support the Alliance expedition in Northrend.
Gara Skullcrush is the Horde Expedition quartermaster. She offers goods to support the Horde expedition in Northrend.

The Borean Tundra Flame Warden tends the Alliance festival flame. The warden welcomes visitors who come to honor it and speaks of Alliance fires across Alliance settlements, while urging them to desecrate Horde fires.

The Borean Tundra Flame Keeper tends the Horde festival flame. The keeper welcomes visitors who come to honor it and speaks of Horde fires across Horde settlements, while urging them to desecrate Alliance fires.
The Winterfin Playmate is a playful humanoid whose brief invitations encourage others to watch what it can do and then dance together.
Durgan Thunderbeak is a Gryphon Keeper in the Borean Tundra who offers goods for visitors to browse.
Tohfo Skyhoof is a Wind Rider Keeper in the Borean Tundra who offers goods for visitors to browse.
Maigra Keenfeather is a named riding trainer whose role centers on teaching riding.
Wind Rider Sabamba is a named riding trainer whose role centers on teaching riding.

place_records.text: You are in Borean Tundra, a contested land of Northrend. The Horde holds Warsong Hold, Bor'gorok Outpost, Taunka'le Village and Mightstone Quarry, the Alliance holds Valiance Keep and Fizzcrank Airstrip, and Amber Ledge and Unu'pe belong to neither side. Scourge and Nerub'ar forces, Kvaldir and Skadir raiders, and magnataur prides are the main dangers, and cultists work near the Alliance keep.

You are in Mightstone Quarry, a Horde settlement in Borean Tundra. Warsong soldiers keep it, and Warden Nork Bloodfrenzy oversees prisoners at an internment camp southeast of Warsong Hold. Nerub'ar skitterers and invaders haunt the quarry, and Shadowstalker Luther's journal reports a Scourge spawning glade in the farms to the west.

You are in Bloodspore Plains, a Horde post on the southern front of Borean Tundra. Bloodmage Laurith studies the bloodspore plants and moths here, and Scout Tungok clears kobolds from the fields. Bloodspore firestarters and harvesters, tundra wolves and magnataur huntresses are the dangers.

You are in Gammoth, a magnataur den west of Bloodspore Plains where the Horde is hunting the pride's leader, Gammothra. Den vermin, bloodspore harvesters and roasters, and Gammoth Tenders lurk among the magnataur, and Bloodmage Alkor is found here.

You are in Amber Ledge, a neutral outpost in Borean Tundra with a flight master and a vendor. Dalaran's Librarian Donathan is here hunting mages abducted across Azeroth, and Librarian Garren charts energy anomalies. Surristrasz, a dragonkin, watches over his drakes, and Warmage Anzim leads war mages from here to Beryl Point. Beryl Reclaimers are the danger nearby.

You are in Coldarra, a ledge in Borean Tundra where a spirit healer serves. Malygos calls out here in concern over Saragosa's fate. Coldarra wyrmkin, spellweavers and spellbinders haunt the ledge, and Coldarra Scalesworn are found among them.

You are in The Westrift, a stretch of Borean Tundra. Captive Winterfin Lurgglbr and Glrglrglr are held in the Winterfin Caverns, and the captives fear that magic seeping from Coldarra controls their kin. Winterfin warriors, shorestrikers and oracles, and glimmer bay orcas are the dangers.

You are in Coast of Echoes, a Horde camp on the shore of Borean Tundra. Garrosh's Landing lies across the mist to the north. Gorge the Corpsegrinder commands siege tanks there against the Scourge, and the mechanic Mobu is trying to repair them. Waltor of Pal'ea seeks the relics the Kvaldir took, and the mist is dangerous.

You are in Riplash Strand, a shore of Borean Tundra where Skadir longboatsmen, raiders and mistweavers are the dangers. The Kvaldir forced captured tuskarr to fight other prisoners here, and a young tuskarr survivor named Karuk is said to have arrived here. Gamel the Cruel and Riplash sorceresses are also dangerous.

You are in Riplash Ruins, a ruin in Borean Tundra where Skadir mariners, runecasters and mistweavers are the dangers. A Warsong marksman engages enemies here, and Ragnar Drakkarlund is among the notable hostile creatures.
You are in Pal'ea, a ruined tuskarr village in Borean Tundra. The Kvaldir destroyed it and took the tuskarr relics, and Kvaldir mist lords and mistweavers now haunt the ruins.

You are in Valiance Keep, an Alliance keep in Borean Tundra with an inn. General Arlos receives reports here, and Harbinger Vurenn pursues intelligence on cultists aiding the Scourge near the keep. Scourged flamespitters and clandestine cultists are the dangers around it.
You are in Winterfin Village, a Winterfin settlement in Borean Tundra. Winterfin warriors, shorestrikers and oracles are the dangers here, and glimmer bay orcas roam the shore.

You are in The Geyser Fields, an area of Borean Tundra. Nerub'ar venomspitters, tunnelers and warriors share the ground with sentry bots, scavenge bots and defendo tanks, which make it dangerous to cross.
You are in Fizzcrank Pumping Station, a gnome pumping station in the pools of Borean Tundra, its gnomes now vanished. Defendo tanks, scavenge bots and sentry bots still patrol its grounds.

You are in Taunka'le Village, a taunka settlement in Borean Tundra held by the Horde. Chieftain Wintergale leads its defence against Scourge pressure from En'kilah, and Greatmother Taiga sends people to look into the mechagnomes in the pools to the west. Its inn and flight master serve travelers.

You are in Coldrock Quarry, a quarry in Borean Tundra where Kaskala craftsmen and shamans were murdered. Their spirits remain there, held by beryl hounds, and beryl reclaimers and treasure hunters roam the site.

You are in Njord's Breath Bay, a bay in Borean Tundra. Elder Muahit, a tuskarr shaman, is here, and Kvaldir attack from the water under Heigarr the Horrible. Iruk, Muahit's nephew, was killed by the Kvaldir, and his body lies in the water north of the bay.

You are in Kaskala, a tuskarr settlement in Borean Tundra. Its families have been sent to Unu'pe, and the warriors left behind fight Kvaldir raiders who attack out of the mist. Ataika and Utaik are among those still here.

You are in Transborea, the tundra crossed on the only route east to the Dragonblight. Taunka'le evacuees and pack kodos pass through, and scourged mammoths, carrion condors, vengeful taunka spirits and frozen elementals are its dangers.

You are in The Flood Plains, a stretch of Borean Tundra where gorlocs roam, among them steam belchers, gibberers and dredgers. A spirit healer here offers a return to life for a price, though the time may not yet be right.

You are in Winterfin Retreat, a murloc settlement in Borean Tundra. King Mrgl-Mrgl leads the unaffected Winterfin murlocs here, and Ahlurglgr, the surviving clam merchant, trades at the camp. Murlocs across the water are now enemies, and a lobstrok named Claximus controls those in the caverns.

You are in Sands of Nasam, Alliance ground in Borean Tundra near Valiance Keep. Medic Hawthorn is treating a soldier poisoned by cryptfiends, and keep footmen and riflemen guard the nearby ground. Crypt crawlers, scourged flamespitters and risen crypt lords roam the sands.
You are in Beryl Point, a point of land in Borean Tundra. Beryl mage hunters and beryl sorcerers roam it, and Inquisitor Salrand is among them.

You are in Garrosh's Landing, a Horde outpost in Borean Tundra. Warsong battleguards and honor guards are among its people, and Mootoo the Younger is searching the mist for her father. Kvaldir mist lords and mistweavers haunt the fog around it.

You are in Fizzcrank Airstrip, an Alliance base in Borean Tundra run by gnomish pilots and engineers. Fizzcrank Fullthrottle leads its airmen, and Mordle Cogspinner is trying to restore the transmatter's outgoing teleport. A magnataur den lies on the southern border, and Crafty Wobblesprocket is building blasters to shrink the beasts. Its inn, blacksmith and flight master serve visitors.

You are in Lake Kum'uya, a lake in Borean Tundra that neither side holds. Bloodspore harvesters, along with wandering divers and hunters, are the dangers on its shores. Bloodspore moths drift over the water.

You are in Farshire, a settlement in Borean Tundra where Alliance settlers are fighting back against the Scourge. Gerald Green has organized the farmers and miners into a militia, and Jeremiah Hawning is trying to rewire harvest collectors to help defend it. Plagued scavengers, cultist necrolytes and crypt crawlers haunt the settlement, and Wendy Darren fears the plague has reached its grain. A spirit healer is nearby.

You are in Unu'pe, a tuskarr village in Borean Tundra that neither side holds. Agloolik keeps the docks, where the great sea turtle Walker of Waves travels from this dock to Moa'ki Harbor in Dragonblight. Caregiver Poallu keeps the inn, and Tonraq is a spearcrafter.

You are in Death's Stand, an Alliance foothold in Borean Tundra where Corporal Venn's small force is pinned down. Undead keep circling the Wailing Ziggurat to the north, and the expedition had a Cult of the Damned spy among its men. Private Casey is looking for Courier Lanson, who was sent to western Dragonblight and has not returned.

You are in The Abandoned Reach, a stretch of beach in Borean Tundra that neither side holds. Hierophant Liandra of D.E.H.T.A. works here against the animal-part trade she blames on Nesingwary's hunters and the Northsea Freebooters. Northsea mercenaries and thugs are the dangers on the shore, and crates of animal parts still wash up among the flotsam.

You are in Scalding Pools, a wreck field in Borean Tundra where a Fizzcrank squadron went down. Iggy Tailspin Cogtoggle, its injured commander, is stranded among the wreckage. Oil-stained wolves prowl the pools, and sentry-bots, scavenge-bots and defendo-tanks still patrol the wrecks.
You are in Steam Springs, a place in Borean Tundra that neither side holds. Steam ragers are the danger here, while marsh caribou and Taunka'le longrunners graze the ground.

You are in Talramas, a crashed necropolis in Borean Tundra held by Scourge cultists. Tinky Wickwhistle, the airstrip's chief transmatter engineer, is caged here by them. Festering ghouls, bone warriors and cult plaguebringers roam the ruins, and Doctor Razorgrin and Lich-Lord Chillwinter lead them.

You are in Festering Pools, a Scourge-infested place in Borean Tundra. Bone warriors, festering ghouls and cult plaguebringers roam among the pools, with sentry-bots, steam ragers and defendo-tanks also about.

You are in The Nexus, a place in Coldarra on the edge of Malygos' lair. Corastrasza, a red dragonflight drake trainer, teaches her drakes here for the coming war with the blue dragonflight. Scalesworn elites, arcane serpents and Coldarra wyrmkin are the dangers here.

You are in Transitus Shield, a resistance outpost in Coldarra that neither side holds. Raelorasz leads its attacks on Malygos and works to rescue captured allies, while Archmage Berinand studies the rift drawn over the Nexus. Librarian Serrah finds provisions for the warmages, and a flight master and repairs are on hand.

You are in Bor'gorok Outpost, a Horde post in Borean Tundra led by Overlord Bor'gorok. Its inn, flight master and stable master serve travelers, and Spirit Talker Snarlfang works with the spirits here. Overlord Bor'gorok worries how the Horde's conduct will shape relations with the taunka, since Steeljaw's caravan disturbed their burial grounds. The wounded Ortrosh still wants revenge on the magnataur at Magmoth.

You are in Magmoth, a cavern near Bor'gorok Outpost in Borean Tundra. Magmoth shamans, crushers and foragers, along with offspring and mates of Magmothregar, fill its depths, and Magmothregar itself lurks there. The spirit of Farseer Grimwalker is bound inside, and the Alliance captive Bonker Togglevolt is chained up by snobolds.
You are in The Dens of Dying, a part of Borean Tundra where plagued magnataur and scourged mammoths roam. Cult plaguebringers and tundra crawlers are found among them.

You are in the Temple City of En'kilah, a Scourge-held city in Borean Tundra. Three plague cauldrons stand here, treated as Scourge weapons. Ghouls, brittle skeletons, gargoyles and crypt fiends are the dangers here, and Thassarian, an Alliance death knight who now fights the Cult of the Damned, is among those present.

You are in the Wailing Ziggurat, a ziggurat in Borean Tundra. Thassarian, an Alliance death knight, works here against the Cult of the Damned, and High Deathpriest Isidorus of that cult begs for mercy when a death knight confronts him. Ziggurat defenders and fleeing cultists are the dangers here. Thassarian seeks the hidden phylactery of the lich Tanathal.

You are in Steeljaw's Caravan, a ruined supply train on sacred taunka burial ground in Borean Tundra. Taunka ghostly sages and risen longrunners rise from the graves, and the cursed spirit of Force-Commander Steeljaw haunts the wreck. Longrunner Proudhoof leads the taunka mourning their ancestors, while the Horde grunt Ragefist insists that the fallen caravan guards and workers be burned rather than left on sacred ground.

You are in Warsong Hold, a Horde hold in Borean Tundra where Overlord Garrosh Hellscream commands the Warsong Offensive. High Overlord Saurfang frets over the strained supply routes. Overlord Razgor warns that Nerub'ar skitterers and web lords are multiplying after their attack on Mightstone Quarry, with the Scourge massed beyond. Its inn and profession trainers serve its warriors.

You are in the Plains of Nasam, a stretch of Borean Tundra where undying aggressors, stitched Warsong horrors and plague spreaders roam, and wooly rhino bulls wander nearby. Kel'Thuzad is among the dangers. Injured Warsong warriors and a mage are found here, and the mage vows that the beasts will feel the Sunwell's fury.

You are in the Ruins of Eldra'nath, where Imperean, an air elemental, speaks with condescension to mortals. Enraged tempests roam the ruins, their rage fed by the ongoing war between fire and water to the south, and Imperean treats their motes as a resource.

You are in the Blistering Pool, a boiling pool in Borean Tundra. Boiling spirits and raging boilers haunt the Blistering Pool, and the elemental Churn is found here, its pool kept boiling by its rival Simmer.

You are in the Spire of Blood, one of three large spires in the Temple City of En'kilah in Borean Tundra. Captives here are bled into blood globes, and the blood is carried up to a necropolis to feed a blood prince. High Priest Andorath is found here too. Snow Tracker Grumm, a badly weakened taunka, is found here after falling into Scourge hands.

You are in the Spire of Pain, one of three large spires in the Temple City of En'kilah in Borean Tundra. En'kilah crypt fiends lurk here, along with mystical webbing, and High Priest Talet-Kha is found here too.

You are in Frozen Reach, a stretch of the Borean Tundra. Marsh caribou roam it, and Unu'pe spearmen are found here too. Carrion condors, Ziggurat defenders and gorloc mud splashers are the dangers, and gorloc dredgers are about as well.

You are in Warsong Slaughterhouse, a Horde spot in the Borean Tundra. Infected kodo beasts are found here, including one of Torp's, and Scourge prisoners are among the people. Unliving swine, En'kilah necrolords and Warsong aberrations are the dangers.

You are in Warsong Farms Outpost, a Horde post on the Borean Tundra's farmland. Farmer Torp is working on a cure for sick kodos here, while Shadowstalkers Ickoris and Canarius work against the Scourge, which turns captured Horde soldiers into undead in these fields. Unliving swine and warsong aberrations are the dangers.

You are in D.E.H.T.A. Encampment, a neutral druid camp in the Borean Tundra. Arch Druid Lathorius champions the animals here, and Hierophant Cenius fiercely opposes Nesingwary's pearl and hunting trade. Zaza condemns Nesingwary's trappers who harm caribou, and enforcers confront anyone accused of harming animals.

You are in Shrine of Scales, in the Borean Tundra. Veehja, a naga priestess, seeks vengeance on the Kvaldir who occupy Riplash. Riplash sorceresses, Skadir mistweavers, longboatsmen and raiders are the dangers.

You are in Winterfin Caverns, in Borean Tundra. Captive Winterfin are held here, and one of them, Lurgglbr, begs for help getting out. Another captive, Glrglrglr, fears that magic seeping down from Coldarra is controlling minds. Winterfin oracles and warriors are hostile here, and Keymaster Urmgrgl keeps the key to a captive's cage.

You are in Naxxanar, a floating Scourge citadel in Borean Tundra. Thassarian, an Alliance man who was forced to serve Arthas as a death knight, is here seeking vengeance against Arthas and working against the Cult of the Damned, whose orders lead back to this citadel. Prince Valanar and Vanthryn the Merciless are among the Scourge who hold it.

You are in North Point Station, in Borean Tundra. Scavenger and sentry bots and a Defendo-tank are hostile here, as is a Fizzcrank mechagnome. Big Electromental Flavor, an elemental, is found in the area too.
